quests.title: Bowls and Beacons
quests.summary: Finish Drake's game of bowls on the Hoe, then light the Armada beacons and warn Exeter.

steps.text: Finish Drake's game: beat the Bowls Captain on the Hoe.
Light the beacon on Plymouth Hoe.
Carry the warning to the beacon on Haldon Hill.
Find the Town Crier on Exeter's High Street.
Report back to 'Sir Francis' on the Hoe.

quests.reward: Drake's Drum (a charm), a Beaconet and standing in England.

quests.title: Last Night in England
quests.summary: Gather the story of the Mayflower's sailing for a display at the Mayflower Steps.

steps.text: Ask the curator of the Elizabethan House about life in 1620.
Hear the Black Friars story at the gin distillery.
Ask the Old Salt on the Barbican quay about the voyage.
Take it all back to the historian by the Mayflower Steps.

quests.reward: Sea glass, flasks of tea and standing in England.

quests.title: The Cream Tea War
quests.summary: Cream first or jam first? Fetch clotted cream for an Exeter tea room and settle it with a Cornish visitor.

steps.text: Fetch clotted cream from the dairy off the B3212.
Bring the cream back to the tea room in Exeter.
Beat Jory, who puts his jam on first.

quests.reward: Devon Scones, Scrumpy and standing in England.

quests.title: Letterboxing
quests.summary: Hunt for letterboxes on the edge of Dartmoor, from the stunted oaks to Cranmere Pool, then face the Hairy Hands.

steps.text: Find the letterbox among the stunted oaks south of the B3212.
Find the letterbox by the Belvedere on Haldon Hill.
Find the first letterbox of all, at Cranmere Pool on Dartmoor.
After dark, catch the Hairy Hands on the B3212.
Show your stamp book to the letterboxer.

quests.reward: A Turned Coat (a charm) and standing in England.
